jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer | Java / React (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Become a Part of ACCURIDS Join us and help shape the future of pharmaceutical data! At ACCURIDS, we’re building the data backbone behind life-science innovation — a system that identifies, links, and standardizes critical enterprise data in compliance with global standards such as ISO IDMP. We help global life-science companies launch products faster, more safely, and with better patient outcomes. At ACCURIDS, you’ll join a collaborative, growth-driven environment where your work makes a real impact from day one. As a key member of our Product Development team, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy while collaborating closely with backend and frontend engineers, QA, DevOps, and product owners. In this role, you will directly align with cross-functional engineering stakeholders and indirectly impact our customers through the features and fixes you deliver, while having direct access to our CTO as a trusted mentor and technical sparring partner How you’ll make an impact: Own features end-to-end: Take full ownership of user-facing features across the stack, from refining business logic in modern Java/Spring Boot to building responsive React/TypeScript interfaces via GraphQL and REST APIs. Amplify velocity with AI: Lead by example in our AI-native engineering culture. You will use tools like Cursor, Claude, or Gemini to accelerate scaffolding, refactoring, and test writing, while acting as the ultimate authority on architectural integrity, security, and quality. As agents take on more of the routine coding, your leverage moves up a level - you direct them, shape the architecture, and own the quality of what ships. Shape next-gen architecture: Drive our evolution toward a multi-module Spring Modulith architecture, optimize complex PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch queries, and dive into domain-specific RDF semantic data structures. Elevate quality & team standards: Raise the bar on engineering hygiene by maintaining rigorous test coverage (JUnit, Testcontainers, Playwright), conducting sharp merge request reviews (including AI-generated code), and mentoring junior engineers. What helps you succeed: Proven SaaS Experience: 5+ years of shipping and owning full-stack features in production software. A degree in Computer Science, Fachinformatiker training, or strong hands-on experience as a career-changer are all welcome. AI-Native Mindset: AI tools (Cursor, Claude and Gemini) are an integral part of your daily workflow. You view AI as an output amplifier, combine high curiosity with deep technical judgment, and reject skepticism toward AI-assisted coding. Location & Work Permit: You are based in Germany within a reasonable commuting distance to our Cologne office (NRW) and hold a valid German work permit. Full-Stack Core Stack: Deep expertise in modern Java (17+), the Spring Boot ecosystem (Spring Security, Spring Data JPA), React 18, TypeScript, Redux, and GraphQL (Apollo Client). Data & Testing Rigor: Strong hands-on experience with SQL/PostgreSQL, Flyway migrations, full-stack testing (Unit, Integration, E2E), and GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Languages: Business fluent English is required; German skills are a strong plus. Bonus Impact: Prior experience with semantic web tools (RDF, SPARQL, Apache Jena), Material UI (MUI 5), Elasticsearch, or pharma/life-sciences domains (FHIR, IDMP) is a major plus. Why you’ll love working here: Impactful Career Growth: Evolve into a Technical Lead / Lead Engineer role or deepen your specialization in semantic data platforms, AI features, or platform architecture as we scale. Epic Office & Hybrid Work: Work from our brand-new office in the KölnTurm, featuring breathtaking views over the city (even higher than the view from the Cologne Cathedral!). Enjoy flexible hybrid options. (Note: On-site presence in Cologne/NRW is required; fully remote work is not offered). Community & Industry Events: Connect and grow your network through exclusive industry events hosted regularly right in our scenic office space. Competitive Compensation: Fixed salary package of €75,000 – €100,000 per year for a full-time, permanent position. Work-Life Balance & Perks: 30 days of paid vacation, a personal learning budget, hardware of your choice (Mac, Linux, Windows), and your choice between a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership or a €50/month City Plus Card. Empowered Culture: High trust, flat hierarchies, and an environment where your decisions directly shape the product. Not ticking every box? Not ticking every box? We encourage you to apply anyway! We know great talent doesn’t always follow a checklist and we care more about your potential, curiosity, and motivation to learn. At ACCURIDS, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially encourage women and people from underrepresented backgrounds in tech, science, and data to apply. jobs.title: Lead QA Engineer
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote (US) About the Role As a Lead QA Engineer, you'll own testing strategy and quality standards across our most important work; Deciding what should be automated, what needs a human eye, where the real risk is hiding, and acting on it. You'll work hands-on across both manual and automated testing, splitting your time based on what a given release actually needs, while mentoring other engineers and acting as the go-to voice on quality across projects. You've got the critical thinking skills to chase down a hard bug yourself, know when to ask for help and delegate, and the range to set direction for how the whole team approaches quality. You seek to help your coworkers and do so regularly. Key Responsibilities Lead test strategy and quality standards across multiple projects, deciding what warrants automated coverage versus focused manual and exploratory testing. Build and maintain automated test suites in Playwright, and use BrowserStack to validate compatibility across browsers, devices, and platforms. Define and run deep manual and exploratory testing on new, ambiguous, or high-change-rate work where automation isn't the right investment yet. Translate requirements into concrete test plans and acceptance criteria, catching gaps in the requirements themselves before they become gaps in the product. Act as the technical point of contact for quality with stakeholders: communicate risk, resolve disagreements about scope, and negotiate realistic testing timelines. Write clear, actionable defect reports in Jira, drive them to resolution, and verify fixes actually hold up under retest rather than just passing a second glance. Use Jira's linking and epic structure to keep testing work traceable, and flag workflow friction in the board with the team before it slows down the SDLC. Mentor other QA engineers in both manual technique and automation practice, including how to write tickets clearly and so well that they need no follow-up clarification, raising the bar on testing across the team, not just on your own projects. Step into any project at any phase to assess its quality risk and recommend a concrete path forward. Stay ahead of testing tools and practices worth adopting, and bring the right ones into real workflows deliberately. Operate and champion the use of AI tooling with an understanding that its output is useful, but not infallible. You treat AI as a tool, not a coworker. Craft & Leadership Balance Estimated 60% leadership, 40% craft. Qualifications Required 6-8 years of experience in software quality assurance or testing, ideally with exposure to consulting or multi-stakeholder environments. Strong, hands-on experience with Playwright for building and maintaining automated test suites and frameworks. Experience using BrowserStack (or a comparable cross-browser/device testing platform) to validate compatibility across platforms. Deep grounding in manual, exploratory, and regression testing, with the judgment to know when automation is and isn't the right investment. Proven ability to translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, actionable test plans and acceptance criteria. Strong Jira practice: writing tickets so well that no follow-up or clarification is needed, using issue-linking for traceability, and spotting workflow friction before it becomes a team-wide problem. Experience testing across a range of CMS or SaaS platforms rather than a single stack, since our client environments vary and this role needs to move between them. Exceedingly strong communication skills, including presenting technical risk and testing tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. It cannot be stressed enough how important this item is: communication is the whole ballgame. Prior experience as a technical or testing lead on large or multi-phase projects. Preferred Familiarity with performance testing (e.g. Lighthouse) and accessibility testing (e.g. Axe, WCAG guidelines). Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. Experience with structured test-case formats (e.g. Gherkin) and test case management tooling. A track record of debugging and performance investigation at scale. Creation and implementation of SDLC processes and norms at project and team scales. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates. jobs.description: We're looking for a QA Engineer to join White Circle , an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems through natural-language policies it automatically tests, enforces, and improves at scale. Backed by $70M (Series A) from top funds and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, and others, White Circle processes 100M+ API calls monthly and trains its own LLMs. This is a manual-first product QA role, with automation as a key tool, in a small team where work ships to production fast. You will Manually test new features and fixes across the web platform and APIs in fast release cycles, sometimes as short as one working day. Identify the highest-risk areas, run exploratory, smoke, regression, and integration testing, and give clear release feedback. Work with engineers and product owners to clarify requirements and improve testability before development is complete. Automate stable, business-critical flows with Playwright and Python, and integrate them into CI/CD. Requirements 2+ years in QA automation, including building frameworks from scratch. Based in or relocating to Paris or London (hybrid). Bonus Testing AI/LLM products: non-deterministic outputs, confidence scoring, edge-case prompts. Performance or load testing (k6, Locust). API testing tools (Postman, Insomnia, Yaak) or contract testing. Security-aware QA or SOC 2 environments. We offer Competitive salary + equity. Hybrid work from Paris or London, relocation package for Paris. Top-tier medical insurance in France and flexible time off. L&D budget, all hardware and tools you need, plus covered AI agent and IDE subscriptions. Team off-sites twice a year. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Automation Engineer (gn) Industrial Robotics & Software Development
jobs.description: Your mission At Wandelbots, we combine modern software development with industrial robotics and automation. With NOVA, we are building a platform that makes the use of industrial robots easier, more flexible, and more software-driven. As an Automation Engineer , you will work right at this intersection: You will commission automation systems and robots, support our teams with your hands-on industrial expertise, and implement customer-specific solutions based on NOVA. You will support projects from technical concept and implementation through to commissioning at the customer site, while bringing insights from real-world automation projects back into our product and engineering teams. WHAT YOU WILL DO Industrial Robotics & Automation You will be responsible for the setup, commissioning, and operation of internal and customer automation systems. jobs.description: About Us Lupa is building a category defining product the industry has never seen before. We are the AI-native operating system for veterinary practices and pet parents, replacing the fragmented, clunky systems vets have tolerated for years with a single intelligent platform for scheduling, client communication, clinical documentation, and AI-driven care guidance. Practices run more efficiently, vets get back to doing what they love, and pet parents feel more connected to their animals health than ever. The traction speaks for itself: one of Europe's top 100 AI startups with a team of 50 people, 10x growth in twelve months, the UK market leader, and now charging hard into the US and Europe. We have $25M in funding, 2.5M+ pets on the platform, and a buzzing HQ in Paddington, London. This is a rare chance to join a rocket ship at exactly the right moment and we are looking for exceptional people to help us fly it. In this role, you will: Own the end to end testing process for your product area alongside dev, from drafting BDD scenarios and acceptance criteria all the way through to release Decide what gets automated and build it. You are not waiting to be told what needs a test, you are making that call yourself Review AI drafted tests and catch flaky tests or visual regressions before they reach merge Run smoke tests and exploratory testing at release and be accountable for releases going out smoothly, not just for finding bugs Work directly with engineers from the start of a feature, not at the end when problems are harder to fix Help shape how the QE function works as we build it from scratch. Early hires leave fingerprints here Your background looks something like: 1 to 3 years of experience in a QE, SDET, or software engineering role, or a strong recent graduate with real coding experience under your belt Comfortable owning both manual and automated testing end to end Hands on experience with Playwright for test automation and TypeScript Confident writing BDD style scenarios from acceptance criteria Genuinely AI fluent. You use AI tools day to day, have opinions on where they help and where they fall short, and know how to review AI generated output critically Mobile automation experience (nice to have) As a person, you: Are proactive by nature. You see what is not working and fix it before being asked Like to innovate and try new things. You are not looking to execute someone else's process, you want to help build the right one Take real ownership of what you ship. A release going out smoothly matters to you personally, not just as a task Thrive with genuine autonomy and are energised by the space to make decisions rather than slowed down by it Are excited to work in person from our Paddington, London HQ Value working with people who are kind, ambitious, and pragmatic What does success look like in 6 months? You own the end to end testing process for at least one product area independently, working directly with dev rather than waiting to be looped in Releases you are responsible for go out smoothly and the team trusts you to make the call on what needs testing and automating without being told You are actively contributing to moving the automation percentage up and your fingerprints are already on how the QE function works Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
